job1.title: Full-Stack PHP / Laravel Developer
job1.description:
• Designed and delivered a customer satisfaction survey module (PHP/Laravel, Vue.js, third-party API) for 60 users, replacing an untracked manual process
• Overhauled business modules (billing, electronic signature) to simplify user journeys and speed up pages, through query, index, and data-loading optimization
• Progressively modernized the legacy Blade interface with Vue.js, using an "Islands Architecture" approach
• Contributed to deployment industrialization via GitLab CI/CD: tests, quality/security checks, build generation, and deployment through the Orange Deployment Engine and Ansible, cutting manual operations from about 1 hour to under 10 minutes
• Fixed over 30 issues, including critical production bugs
• Tracked the application's migration to a secure Linux hosting environment in Orange's private cloud
• Presented achievements to business stakeholders and worked in an Agile/Scrum methodology
job1.tools: PHP, Laravel, Vue.js, MySQL, REST API, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Linux, Ansible, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Gitleaks, Agile/Scrum, Jira, Confluence

job2.title: Python Web Developer Intern
job2.description:
• Develop an absence planning website: automated data extraction from the HR software, normalization and storage in an internal database, monthly and yearly views with a filter form
• Develop a stock management interface connected to Sage X3: barcode scanning, quantity entry, stock-out validation, ERP updates, and an item cache to speed up the application
• Ensure traceability and security: operations history, error handling with clear messages, authentication via OAuth2 / OpenID Connect
• Structure the code in a modular way (Flask blueprints, SQLAlchemy ORM), with separate development and production environments, versioned with Git
• Deploy the absence planning tool on the company's server, used daily by employees with very positive feedback
job2.tools: Python, Flask, SQLite, SQLAlchemy, Bootstrap, OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, Sage X3, Git

degree3.title: 1st Year Master's in Computer Science (IS & Web)

project1.name: with.dev
project1.description: Ongoing design and development of an IT recruitment platform, exposing a documented REST API (OpenAPI) with multi-criteria job search and candidate profile management (DTOs via MapStruct). Data persistence handled with Hibernate/JPA on PostgreSQL (Supabase), with build and dependency management via Maven. The application is secured as a stateless resource server, using Supabase Auth JWTs validated through JWKS, with candidate/recruiter roles and clear separation between public and protected routes. Layered architecture (API / domain / infrastructure), covered by over 260 automated tests (JUnit, Mockito, Vitest, Testing Library). The whole stack is containerized with Docker Compose (PostgreSQL, backend, frontend) and integrated into a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline handling build, tests, and delivery of versioned Docker images (GHCR).
project1.tools: Java 21, Spring Boot 4, Hibernate/JPA, Maven, React, TypeScript, API REST, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitHub Actions, Supabase Auth

project2.name: Absence Planning
project2.description: Web application developed during my internship at Provençale SA and deployed on the company’s internal servers for employee use. It enables visualization of employee absences in both monthly and yearly views, with automated data extraction from the Nibelis HR system using BeautifulSoup. Secure authentication is implemented via the company’s OAuth2/AD FS infrastructure. The screenshots provided are approximate representations based on fictitious data, in order to comply with company confidentiality requirements.
